import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int N = 50;
    static final int M = 50;
    static final int K = 50;
    static final int T = N + K + 1;
    static final int N_ = N * T + 1;
    static final int M_ = K + (M * 2 * K + N) * (T - 1);
    static final int INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;

    static int[] pi = new int[N_];
    static int[] kk = new int[N_];
    static int[] bb = new int[N_];
    static int[] pq = new int[1 + N_];
    static int[] iq = new int[N_];
    static int cnt;

    static class Edge {
        Edge next;
        int j;
        Edge(Edge next, int j) {
            this.next = next;
            this.j = j;
        }
    }

    static Edge[] aa = new Edge[N];
    static Edge[] aa_ = new Edge[N_];

    static void add(int i, int j) {
        aa[i] = new Edge(aa[i], j);
    }

    static void add_(int i, int h) {
        aa_[i] = new Edge(aa_[i], h);
    }

    static int[] uu = new int[M_];
    static int[] vv = new int[M_];
    static int[] uv = new int[M_];
    static int[] cost = new int[M_];
    static int[] cost_ = new int[M_];
    static int[] cc = new int[M_ * 2];

    static void link(int u, int v, int cap, int cos) {
        int h = m_++;
        uu[h] = u;
        vv[h] = v;
        uv[h] = u ^ v;
        cost[h] = cos;
        cc[h << 1 ^ 0] = cap;
        add_(u, h << 1 ^ 0);
        add_(v, h << 1 ^ 1);
    }

    static boolean LT(int u, int v) {
        return pi[u] < pi[v] || (pi[u] == pi[v] && kk[u] < kk[v]);
    }

    static void pq_up(int u) {
        int i, j;
        for (i = iq[u]; (j = i / 2) != 0 && LT(u, pq[j]); i = j) {
            pq[iq[pq[j]] = i] = pq[j];
        }
        pq[iq[u] = i] = u;
    }

    static void pq_dn(int u) {
        int i, j;
        for (i = iq[u]; (j = i2(i)) != 0 && LT(pq[j], u); i = j) {
            pq[iq[pq[j]] = i] = pq[j];
        }
        pq[iq[u] = i] = u;
    }

    static int i2(int i) {
        i *= 2;
        return i > cnt ? 0 : (i < cnt && LT(pq[i + 1], pq[i])) ? i + 1 : i;
    }

    static void pq_add(int u) {
        iq[u] = ++cnt;
        pq_up(u);
    }

    static int pq_remove_first() {
        int u = pq[1], v = pq[cnt--];
        iq[v] = 1;
        pq_dn(v);
        return u;
    }

    static int m_ = 0;

    static void dijkstra(int s) {
        Arrays.fill(pi, INF);
        pi[s] = 0;
        cnt = 0;
        pq_add(s);
        while (cnt > 0) {
            int u = pq_remove_first();
            for (Edge l = aa_[u]; l != null; l = l.next) {
                int h_ = l.j;
                if (cc[h_] > 0) {
                    int h = h_ >> 1;
                    int p = pi[u] + ((h_ & 1) == 0 ? cost_[h] : -cost_[h]);
                    int v = u ^ uv[h];
                    if (pi[v] == INF) {
                        pi[v] = p;
                        kk[v] = kk[u] + 1;
                        bb[v] = h_;
                        pq_add(v);
                    } else if (pi[v] > p || (pi[v] == p && kk[v] > kk[u] + 1)) {
                        pi[v] = p;
                        kk[v] = kk[u] + 1;
                        bb[v] = h_;
                        pq_up(v);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void push(int s, int t) {
        for (int u = t; u != s; u ^= uv[(bb[u]) >> 1]) {
            int h_ = bb[u];
            cc[h_]--;
            cc[h_ ^ 1]++;
        }
    }

    static int edmonds_karp(int s, int t) {
        System.arraycopy(cost, 0, cost_, 0, m_);
        while (true) {
            dijkstra(s);
            if (pi[t] == INF) break;
            push(s, t);
            for (int h = 0; h < m_; h++) {
                int u = uu[h], v = vv[h];
                if (pi[u] != INF && pi[v] != INF)
                    cost_[h] += pi[u] - pi[v];
            }
        }
        int c = 0;
        for (int h = 0; h < m_; h++)
            c += cost[h] * cc[h << 1 ^ 1];
        return c;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        int c = sc.nextInt();
        int d = sc.nextInt();
        int[] ii = new int[K];
        for (int h = 0; h < k; h++) {
            ii[h] = sc.nextInt() - 1;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            int i1 = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            int j = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            add(i1, j);
            add(j, i1);
        }
        int t = n + k + 1;
        int n_ = n * t + 1;
        m_ = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int s = 0; s < t - 1; s++) {
                int u = i * t + s;
                for (Edge l = aa[i]; l != null; l = l.next) {
                    int j = l.j;
                    int v = j * t + s + 1;
                    for (int x = 1; x <= k; x++) {
                        link(u, v, 1, c + (x * 2 - 1) * d);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int s = 0; s < t - 1; s++) {
                int u = i * t + s;
                int v = u + 1;
                link(u, v, k, i == 0 ? 0 : c);
            }
        }
        for (int h = 0; h < k; h++) {
            link(n_ - 1, ii[h] * t + 0, 1, 0);
        }
        System.out.println(edmonds_karp(n_ - 1, 0 * t + t - 1));
    }
}
